action_summary: Retained the existing four-fold DeBERTa-large ensemble and Kaggle paths. Added an 85% prefix / 15% head-plus-ending view blend for truncated essays, with length-sorted batching and order restoration. When complete disjoint per-fold validation exports are available, the pipeline recomputes OOF predictions, rejects the extra view unless QWK improves consistently, and cross-fits bounded, shrunken ordinal cutpoints; absent exports, it retains the supplied cutpoints and conservative view blend. Cached raw predictions and joined integer submission scores by essay_id. This follows the planning guidance on fold averaging, prediction caching, and metric-aligned validation without introducing unavailable model families. Only syntax and JSON checks were run locally; no training or inference was run, and leaderboard improvement is unmeasured. Validation exports are identified by the existing pred_df_foldN.csv convention; pooled single-fold OOF calibration may not exactly match the variance of averaged test predictions.
